purpose: Construct an explicit conditioned PASSAGE_STATE before specialist diagnosis or revision.

scope_rules.SURGICAL: May proceed when local purpose, POV, protected language, and relevant canon are known.
scope_rules.LOCAL_RESTRUCTURE: Also requires reader-state, pacing, information-release, and character-pressure confidence.
scope_rules.SUBSTANTIAL_REWORK: Also requires book/project voice, broader continuity, authorial intent, and scene/chapter role confidence.
scope_rules.APPROACH_CHALLENGE: Requires explicit development-frontier intent or user authorization plus all preservation authorities.
